description: SVG minimap overlay for the wireframe canvas. Renders a scaled-down thumbnail of the full document with a viewport indicator rectangle. Clicking or dragging on the minimap pans the main canvas. Selected elements are highlighted. Typically rendered as an overlay inside TmWireframeDesignerCanvas via TmWireframeEditor.

parameters.name: Document
parameters.description: Document whose elements are rendered in the minimap.

parameters.name: SelectedIds
parameters.description: Currently selected element IDs – highlighted in the minimap.

parameters.name: Viewport
parameters.description: Current visible viewport region in document coordinates. Updated by the canvas on pan/zoom.

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: Width of the minimap in pixels.

parameters.name: NavigateRequested
parameters.description: Raised when the user clicks/drags on the minimap. Parent should pan the canvas to the requested centre point.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class applied to the minimap wrapper.

relatedTypes.name: MinimapViewport
relatedTypes.description: Current viewport region: X, Y, Width, Height in document coordinates.

relatedTypes.name: MinimapNavigateArgs
relatedTypes.description: Navigate-to request: CentreX, CentreY in document coordinates.

examples.title: Minimap bound to canvas viewport
examples.code:
<TmWireframeMinimap Document="_document"
                    SelectedIds="_selectedIds"
                    Viewport="_viewport"
                    Width="180"
                    NavigateRequested="OnMinimapNavigate" />

@code {
    private MinimapViewport? _viewport;

    private async Task OnMinimapNavigate(MinimapNavigateArgs args)
    {
        if (_canvas is not null)
            await _canvas.ScrollTo(args.CentreX, args.CentreY);
    }
}
